result:
I've looked at the spreadsheet you described: one row per loan, with Seed, Packets, Borrower, Date out and Date back. About a third of the Date back cells are empty. That could mean many packets are still out, or that returns happen and nobody records them. Those two problems would lead to quite different tools, so I don't want to guess.

What I've got so far: you want a more reliable way to see what seeds have gone out, who has them, and what has come back. It's for your community garden's seed library, and it would replace or improve the shared spreadsheet. Correct me if I've got any of that wrong.

What's going wrong with the spreadsheet today that made you want something better? Your answer tells me what the new tool most needs to fix.
